commit.subject: LU-20985 mdt: fix rename locking issue
commit.message:
LU-20985 mdt: fix rename locking issue

A PROTOTYPE

it's not enough to check whether the source directory is a child
of the target directory. we must do a reverse check as well, but
this kind of check is racy unless we serialize all cross-dir
renames which is not cheap.

instead we can try to get 2nd lock and if failed - try to enqueue
again starting from the failed one.

add sanity/81k test to verify the fix.

Test-Parameters: fortestonly env=ONLY=81e testlist=sanityn
Signed-off-by: Alex Zhuravlev <bzzz@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: I063fd57e124a142ad70bed855d4f2426d739a09c
